Reference this summary in Decision 10 for the mid-session re-enable flow.

resolutions.rationale: Valid calibrated-claims and comprehension gap (`feature-spec-standard.md` §6): `design.md` claims same-boundary `context_edit`s cannot be overwritten without explaining Pi's sequential handler order in `ExtensionRunner.emitBoundary`, where `event.entries` only holds drafts from handlers that ran *before* taiknr.

Valid internal contradiction in `design.md`: Decision 7 literally places `return [...event.entries, ...]` before draining into `store` and mutates `pendingOutputs`/`originalContentByEntryId` before `toSettlementDrafts`, contradicting Decision 11's statement that drafts are built before mutating state.
resolutions.required_change:
1. Rewrite the step sequence in `design.md` Decision 7 so all pure reads and draft construction precede every state mutation and `return` is last: (1) read `ctx.sessionManager.getBranch()` and `event.entries`, build the active-branch `toolResult` ID `Set` and existing-`context_edit` `targetId` `Set`, and partition `pendingOutputs` non-mutatingly into `committable` and `dropped`; (2) if `committable.length === 0`, remove `dropped` items from `pendingOutputs` in place, delete their `originalContentByEntryId` keys, and return `undefined`; (3) call `const drafts = toSettlementDrafts(committable, originalContentByEntryId)` (`[sideStoreDraft, ...contextEditDrafts]`) before mutating `pendingOutputs`, `originalContentByEntryId`, or `store` (so any throw leaves all three untouched); (4) remove `dropped` items from `pendingOutputs` in place and delete their `originalContentByEntryId` keys, then call `commitArchivedBatch(pendingOutputs, store)` (draining the remaining `committable` items into `store`) and delete the committed keys from `originalContentByEntryId`; (5) return `{ entries: [...event.entries, ...drafts] }`.
2. In `design.md` Decision 11, state the matching build-before-mutate failure boundary for the other handlers: `turn_end` computes `candidates` and `staged` before pushing to `pendingOutputs` or writing `originalContentByEntryId`; `session_start`, `session_tree`, and `session_compact` finish `readArchiveBatchesFromBranch(ctx.sessionManager.getBranch())` before `hydrateArchiveStore` calls `store.replaceAll`; any unexpected throw propagates to Pi's extension error channel without partial mutation.
